hero.eyebrow: The archive · eleven bodies of work
hero.title: αλήθεια
hero.intro: Aletheia. Greek: truth as unconcealment rather than correctness. My own name for the collection, used as a tag in my private archive for years.

entries.title: The Treatise
entries.excerpt: A treatise on sound, vibration, consciousness, and what we are relative to physical reality.

entries.title: Inner Work
entries.excerpt: Inner and outer reality as reflections of each other — and a warning about what happens to people who mistake the insight for an identity.

entries.title: Essence
entries.excerpt: Absolute truth as a coin whose other side is disgust — and an essence that mocks you into nothing before it completes you.

entries.title: Complexes and Addiction
entries.excerpt: A subpersonality feeding the ego, and the urgency it manufactures — chemically addicting, and disguised as a search for truth.

entries.title: Abstinence and Integration
entries.excerpt: Only in abstinence can we observe ourselves in the nude. We may find our bare being ugly — the point is to see it, and then integrate.

entries.title: Symbol and Archetype
entries.excerpt: Medusa as what happens when you don't take control of the great conflict. Athena as what happens when you do.

entries.title: Time and Synchronicity
entries.excerpt: A 2D bug crossing sheets of paper it can't perceive as separate — and God as a thirteenth-dimensional sphere casting shadows down to us.

entries.title: Duality and Nothingness
entries.excerpt: Duality only exists within the human mind — and a note about why he writes any of this down at all.

entries.title: Reprogramming
entries.excerpt: We are bioelectric beings. Change your state of mind and there are literally physical changes to your brain.

entries.title: Power and Attention
entries.excerpt: A talk on AI and the totalitarian state, a campaign's marketing decision, and an academic paper on cultural imperialism.

entries.title: Early Work
entries.excerpt: A time-travel plot written in the Notes app in 2011, and two rants from 2022.
